bifrost: No app extension model. Nearby: springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs, springboard/sdk/src/control.rs, springboard/sdk/src/intents.rs
summary: Apps run as sandboxed processes, but there is no API for an app to declare extension points, discover extensions from other packages, or launch them as separate processes with a connection. Related features (App Intents, share, app control socket) cover fixed system integrations only.

features.feature: Adding support for app extensions to your app
features.apple: Extension model: define extension points, talk to extensions at runtime
features.note: built on parity/team-a-05; not yet verified on Midget. The extension model (points, identities, registry and process table) from wave 1 covers this row, which was stale. Pure model, not wired into the shell.

features.apple: Declare extension content and handle incoming XPC connections
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 9 tests. Wave 3 (theme-21, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Control socket serves the app's own methods; no extension bundle type or connection handler

features.apple: Host launches extension in a separate process
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Shell launches sandboxed app processes (bubblewrap, cgroups); only for whole apps, not host-requested extensions

features.apple: Declare host extension points and bind extensions to them
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No third-party extension points; intents and share are fixed system channels
